name: Veld Monitor Controls
description:
Brightness, contrast, input, color and audio controls for external monitors in GNOME Quick Settings.

* Per-monitor brightness and a master slider above volume
* Contrast, monitor volume and mute, input source, color preset and optional RGB gain
* OSD feedback, keyboard shortcuts, custom display names and visibility
* Fast ddcutil-service backend with automatic ddcutil CLI fallback

Requires ddcutil and a DDC/CI-capable monitor. Local only: no telemetry and no network access.
